Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce.  About the role: 
 We are looking for a Campaign Manager - AI Operations who will own the end-to-end execution and success of AI-powered voice and Agentic AI campaigns. 
 The role will involve creating AI voice agents, writing and optimizing prompts, designing conversational journeys, launching campaigns, monitoring performance, analyzing AI interactions, and continuously improving the agent to drive measurable business outcomes. 
 The candidate should have a strong combination of operations understanding, prompt engineering, conversational AI, analytical thinking, and execution skills . 
 Role Expectations/ Responsibilities: 
 AI Agent Creation: Build and configure AI voice agents for different merchant use cases by defining conversation journeys, agent behavior, business rules, objection handling, and closure logic. Prompt Engineering: Write, test, and continuously optimize production-ready prompts to ensure the AI agent follows the required conversation flow, understands merchant responses, asks relevant questions, handles objections, and drives the intended outcome. Conversational Journey Design: Translate business requirements and operational processes into structured AI conversations covering opening, intent identification, probing, resolution, objection handling, confirmation, and closure. Agentic AI Optimization: Work on improving the agents ability to understand context, make appropriate decisions, use available tools, follow business rules, and complete the intended merchant journey autonomously. Quality Management: Partner with QA teams to define AI quality parameters, conduct regular audits, identify critical quality/compliance gaps, and implement corrective actions. Business Outcome Management: Ensure AI campaigns are optimized for measurable business outcomes and not only operational metrics such as call connectivity. A/B Testing Experimentation: Design and execute experiments across prompts, conversation flows, scripts, retry strategies, and campaign configurations to improve campaign performance. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data, QA, Business, and Operations teams to develop, launch, troubleshoot, and scale AI campaigns. Documentation Governance: Maintain campaign documentation including prompts, conversation flows, business rules, test cases, success metrics, changes, and deployment requirements.

 The role will be measured across AI quality, campaign performance, business outcomes, and operational efficiency , including: 
 AI campaign connect rateSuccessful outcome / conversion rate Merchant retention and activation AI conversation quality score AHT and call efficiency FCR / successful resolution Prompt and AI agent performance improvement Reduction in hallucinations and critical compliance issues Retry effectiveness Cost per successful outcome Campaign launch timelines Automation and manual effort reduction
